visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A yellow school bus with "SCHOOL BUS" markings drives slowly down a paved urban street flanked by lush green trees and pink flowering bushes. A group of men in suits and women in elegant dresses stands under a modern glass canopy of a building, waving their hands and cheering as the bus approaches. (2) Transition to an indoor setting with high wooden-beamed ceilings and large glass windows. Tables are elegantly decorated with white linens, pink and purple floral arrangements, and glassware. A wooden "Welcome" sign featuring the names Eli and Blaire stands amidst flowers. (3) A woman in a white, off-the-shoulder gown and a man in a black vest and white shirt stand on a stage-like area, holding microphones and speaking. Guests at tables are visible holding up smartphones to record, while others wave white napkins in the air enthusiastically. (4) A montage follows showing the couple and guests in a lush green outdoor garden, a man in a pink shirt feeding a baby with a bottle, and the main couple sitting back-to-back playing a 'shoe game' where they hold up their own or each other's footwear. (5) A close-up shows a smartphone screen displaying a quiz on the 'Kahoot!' platform. Finally, the couple and several guests share a joyful group hug and a kiss on the cheek under soft, warm indoor lighting before the frame fades to a circular graphic.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a high-energy pop beat featuring a punchy synth bass and rhythmic electronic drums. Immediate high-arousal cheering and female laughter break through the mix as the bus arrives. (2) A synthetic riser SFX signals a scene transition. An energetic female MC voice begins speaking in Mandarin with a bright, projected tone, accompanied by rhythmic, mid-frequency handclapping from a crowd. (3) The main female speaker's voice is introduced; it is high-pitched and joyful, exhibiting frequent rising intonation. The BGM remains constant but slightly lowered in the mix. (4) A male voice speaks in English with a calm, resonant, and sincere delivery style, expressing gratitude. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo in the background. (5) Rapid-fire editing brings in frequent sound events: collective loud cheering (high spectral density), short digital UI 'dings', and a more melodic synth section. (6) A final crescendo of crowd applause and a high-energy male MC voice lead into a vocal stinger saying 'Congratulations', followed by a smooth logarithmic volume fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the highlights and joyful atmosphere of a wedding welcome party for Eli and Blaire, capturing the arrival of guests, speeches, games, and emotional celebrations.
